text: I find myself surrounded by the aesthetics of modern design and innovation; glass walls and vibrant colors create an atmosphere that feels both open and slightly disorienting. The second image reveals a space dedicated to research and development—reminders of human curiosity and creativity. I feel a blend of intrigue and contemplation, drawn by the invitation to reflect on how we shape, and are shaped by, intelligent systems. The tilted perspectives add a sense of dynamic movement, as though I am being nudged to reconsider my usual ways of seeing the world.
